Avodah Zarah 2a:2-5a:5: Gemara rav ushemuel, chad tane "edehen", vechad tane "edehen". man detane "edehen" la mishtabbash, uman detane "edehen" la mishtabbash.
Man detane "edehen" la mishtabbash, dichtiv: "ki karov yom edam", uman detane "edehen" la mishtabbash, dichtiv: "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku".

Uman detane "edehen", may tama la tane "edehen"? amar lach: tevara adif. uman detane "edehen", may tama la tane "edehen"? amar lach: man ka garem lehu tevara? edut sheheidu beatzman, hilkach edut adifa.

Vehay "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku" beummot haolam ketiv? ha beyisrael ketiv, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol mitzvot sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze baot umeidot lahem laolam habba, shenneemar: "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku" — ellu yisrael, "yishmeu veyomru emet" — ellu ummot haolam.
Ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: man deamar "edehen" — mehacha: "yotzre fesel kullam tohu vachamudehem bal yoilu veedehem hemma".
Daresh rabbi chanina bar pappa, veittema rabbi simlay: leatid lavo mevi hakkadosh baruch hu sefer tora umannicho becheko, veomer: lemi sheasak bah yavo veyittol secharo.
Miyyad mitkabbetzin uvain ummot haolam beirbuveya, shenneemar: "kol haggoyim nikbetzu yachdav vegomer", omer lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: al tikkansu lefanay beirbuveya, ella tikkanes kol umma veummah

Vesofreha, shenneemar: "veyeasfu leummim", veen "leom" ella malchut, shenneemar: "uleom milleom yeematz". umi ikka irbuveya kamme hakkadosh baruch hu? ella ki hechi dela liarbevu inhu [bahade hadade], delishmeu may deamar lehu.

[Miyyad] nichnesa lefanav malchut romi techilla. may tama? mishshum dachashiva. umenalan dachashiva? dichtiv: "vetechul kol ara utedushinna vetaddekinna". amar rabbi yochanan: zo romi chayyevet shettivah yatza bechol haolam.

Umena lan deman dachashiv ayel beresha? kidrav chisda, deamar rav chisda: melech vetzibbur — melech nichnas techilla ledin, shenneemar: "laasot mishpat avdo umishpat ammo yisrael vegomer". vetama may? ibbaet ema: lav orach ara lemetav malka meabbaray, veibbaet ema: mikkamme delipposh charon af.

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: bemay asaktem? omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, harebe shevavkim tikanneynu, harebe merchatzaot asinu, harebe kesef vezahav hirbenu, vechullam lo asinu ella bishvil yisrael kede sheyyitasseku betora.

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: shotim shebbaolam, kol ma sheasitem letzorech atzmechem asitem, tikkantem shevavkim lehoshiv bahen zonot, merchatzaot leadden bahen atzmechem, kesef vezahav shelli hu, shenneemar: "li hakkesef veli hazzahav neum Adonai tzevaot".
Kelum yesh bachem maggid zot? shenneemar: "mi vachem yaggid zot", veen "zot" ella tora, shenneemar: "vezot hattora asher sam moshe". miyyad yatzu befache nefesh.

Yatzat malchut romi, venichnesa malchut paras achareha. may tama? deha chashiva batra. umenalan? dichtiv: "vaaru cheva ochori tinyana damya ledov", vetane rav yosef: ellu parsiyyim, sheochlin veshotin kedov, umesurebalin [basar] kedov, umegaddelin sear kedov, veen lahem menucha kedov.

Omer lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: bemay asaktem? omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, harebe gesharim gasharnu, harebe kerakkim kavashnu, harebe milchamot asinu, vechullam lo asinu ella bishvil yisrael kede sheyyitasseku battora.

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: kol ma sheasitem letzorech atzmechem asitem, tikkantem gesharim littol mehem meches, kerakkim laasot bahem angarya, milchamot ani asiti, shenneemar: "Adonai ish milchama", kelum yesh bachem maggid zot? shenneemar: "mi vachem yaggid zot", veen "zot" ella tora, shenneemar: "vezot hattora asher sam moshe", miyyad yatzu millefanav befache nefesh.
Vechi meachar dachazayt malchut paras lemalchut romi dela mahneya vela midde, may tama ayyla? amri: inhu satri bet hammikdash vaanan baninan, vechen lechol umma veuma.

Vechi meachar dachazo lekammae dela mahane vela midde, may tama ayyli? savri: hanach ishtabadu behu beyisrael, vaanan la shabadnu beyisrael. may shena hane dachashivi, umay shena hane dela chashivi lehu? mishshum dehanach mashchi bemalchutayyhu ad deate meshicha.

Omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kelum natatta lanu velo kibbalnuha? umi matze lememar hachi? vehachtiv: "vayyomar Adonai missinay ba vezarach misseir lamo", uchetiv: "eloah mitteman yavo vegomer". may bae beseir, umay bae befaran?
Amar rabbi yochanan: melammed shehechzirah hakkadosh baruch hu al kol umma velashon, velo kibbeluha, ad shebba etzel yisrael vekibbeluha!

Ella hachi amri: kelum kibbalnuha velo kiyyaymnuha? veal da tevartehon, ammay la kabbeltuha? ella kach omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kelum kafita alenu har kegigit velo kibbalnuha, kemo sheasita leyisrael?

Dichtiv: "vayyityatztzevu betachtit hahar", veamar rav dimi bar chama: melammed shekkafa hakkadosh baruch hu har kegigit al yisrael, veamar lahem: im attem mekabbelin et hattora — mutav, veim lav — sham tehe kevuratchem!
Miyyad omer lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: harishonot yashmiunu, shenneemar: "verishonot yashmiunu", sheva mitzvot shekkibbaltem hechan kiyyaymtem?

Umenalan delo kiyyeymum? detane rav yosef: "amad vaymoded eretz raa vayyatter goyim", may raa? raa sheva mitzvot shekkibbelu alehen bene noach velo kiyyeymum, kevan shello kiyyeymum amad vehittiran lahen. ittegore ittegur? im ken matzinu chote niskar!
Amar mar bereh deravina:
Lomar, sheaf al pi shemmekayyeymin otan en mekabbelin alehem sachar.

Vela? vehatanya: haya rabbi meir omer: minnayin sheafillu goy veosek battora shehu kechohen gadol? talmud lomar: "asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem", kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim lo neemar, ella "haadam", ha lamadta sheafillu goy veosek battora hare hu kechohen gadol.
Ella lomar lach, sheen mekabbelin alehem sachar kimtzvvev veose, ella kemi sheeno metzvvev veose, deamar rabbi chanina: gadol hametzvvev veose yoter mishsheeno metzvvev veose.
Ella kach omrim haggoyim lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, yisrael shekkibbeluha hechan kiyyeymuha?

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: ani meid bahem shekkiyyeymu et hattora kullah. omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kelum yesh av shemmeid al beno? dichtiv: "beni bechori yisrael". amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: shamayim vaaretz yaidu bahem shekkiyyeymu et hattora kullah.

Omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, shamayim vaaretz nogin beedutan, shenneemar: "im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti", (deamar) [veamar] rabbi shimon ben lakish: may dichtiv: "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom hashshishshi"? melammed shehitna hakkadosh baruch hu im maase vereshit, veamar: im yisrael mekabbelin et torati mutav, veim lav — ani achazir etchem letohu vavohu.
Vehayeynu deamar chizkiyya, may dichtiv: "mishshamayim hishmata din eretz yara veshakata"? im yara lamma shakta, veim shakta lamma yara? ella battechilla yara, ulevassof shakta.

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: mikkem yavou veyaidu bahen beyisrael shekkiyyeymu et hattora kullah, yavo nimrod veyaid beavraham shello avad avoda zara, yavo lavan veyaid beyaakov shello nechshad al haggazel, tavo eshet potifera vetaid beyosef shello nechshad al haavera.

Yavo nevuchadnetztzar veyaid bachananya mishael vaazarya shello hishtachavu latztzelem, yavo daryavesh veyaid bedaniyyel shello bittel et hattefilla, yavo bildad hashshuchi vetzofar hannaamati veelifaz hattemani veelihu ben barachel habbuzi veyaidu bahem beyisrael shekkiyyeymu et kol hattora kullah, shenneemar: "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku".

Amru lefanav: ribbono shel olam, teneha lanu merosh venaasenna. amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu: shotim shebbaolam! mi shettarach beerev shabbat yochal beshabbat, mi shello tarach beerev shabbat mehechan yochal beshabbat? ella af al pi chen, mitzva kalla yesh li vesukka shemah, lechu vaasu otah.
Umi matzet amrat hachi? veha amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv "asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom", hayyom laasotam velo lemachar laasotam, hayyom laasotam velo hayyom littol sachar.
Ella, sheen hakkadosh baruch hu ba bitruneya im beriyyotav. veammay kare leh "mitzva kalla"? mishshum delet bay chesron kis.

Miyyad kol echad veechad notel veholech veose sukka berosh gaggo, vehakkadosh baruch hu makdir alehem chamma bitkufat tammuz, vechol echad veechad mevaet besukkato veyotze, shenneemar: "nenatteka et mosrotemo venashlicha mimmennu avotemo". makdir? veha amrat: en hakkadosh baruch hu ba bitruneya im beriyyotav! mishshum deyisrael name zimne
Demashcha lehu tekufat tammuz ad chagga, vehave lehu tzaara. vehaamar rava: mitztaer patur min hassukka! nehi defatur, baote mi mevaati?
Miyyad, hakkadosh baruch hu yoshev umesachek alehen, shenneemar: "yoshev bashshamayim yischak vegomer". amar rabbi yitzchak: en sechok lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ella oto hayyom bilvad.

Ikka dematne leha derabbi yitzchak aha, detanya: rabbi yose omer: leatid lavo bain ummot haolam umitgayyeyrin. umi mekabbelinan minnayyhu? vehatanya: en mekabbelin gerim limot hammashiach, kayyotze vo lo kibbelu gerim lo bime david velo bime shelomo!
Ella shennaasu gerim gerurim, umannichin tefillin berashehen, tefillin bizrootehem, tzitzit bevigdehem, mezuza befitchehem.
Kevan sheroin milchemet gog umagog, omer lahen: al ma batem? omrim lo: al Adonai veal meshicho, shenneemar: "lamma ragshu goyim uleummim yehgu rik vegomer",

Vechol echad menattek mitzvato veholech, shenneemar: "nenatteka et mosrotemo vegomer", vehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev umesachek, shenneemar: "yoshev bashshamayim yishchak vegomer". amar rabbi yitzchak: en lo lehakkadosh baruch hu sechok ella oto hayyom bilvad.

Ini? veha amar rav yehuda amar rav: shetem esre shaot have hayyom, shalosh harishonot — hakkadosh baruch hu yoshev veosek battora, sheniyyot — yoshev vedan et kol haolam kullo, kevan sheroe shennitchayyev olam kelayay — omed mikkisse haddin veyoshev al kisse rachamim,

Shelishiyyot — yoshev vezan et kol haolam kullo mikkarne remim ad betze chinnim, reviiyyot — yoshev umesachek im livyatan, shenneemar: "livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo", amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: im beriyyotav mesachek, veal beriyyotav eno mesachek ella oto hayyom bilvad.

Amar leh rav acha lerav nachman bar yitzchak: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en sechok lehakkadosh baruch hu. umenalan delekka sechok? illema middichtiv: "vayyikra Adonai elohim tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulemisped ulekorcha vegomer", dilma hahu yoma vetu la!

Ella dichtiv: "im eshkachech yerushalam tishkach yemini tidbak leshoni lechikki im lo ezkerechi", dilma shichcha hu delekka, aval sechok miha ikka! ella meha: "hechesheti meolam acharish etappak vegomer".

Birviiyyot may aved? yoshev umelammed tinokot shel bet rabban tora, shenneemar: "et mi yore dea veet mi yavin shemua gemule mechalav attike mishshadayim". lemi yore dea ulemi yavin shemua? ligmule mechalav uleattike mishshadayim.
Umeikkara man hava maygmar lehu? ibbaet ema: metatron, veibbaet ema: ha veha aved.

Uvelelya may aved? ibbaet ema: meen yemama, veibbaet ema: rochev al keruv kal shello veshat bishmona asar elef olamot, shenneemar: "rechev elohim ribbotayim alfe shinan", al tikre "shinan" ella "sheenan", veibbaet ema: yoshev veshomea shira mippi chayyot, shenneemar: "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi".

Amar rabbi levi: kol happosek middivre tora veosek bedivre sicha maachilin lo gachale retamim, shenneemar: "hakkotfim malluach ale siach veshoresh retamim lachmam". amar resh lakish: kol haosek battora ballayla hakkadosh baruch hu moshech alav chut shel chesed bayyom, shenneemar: "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi". ma taam "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo"? mishshum devallayla shiro immi.

Ikka deamri, amar resh lakish: kol haosek battora baolam hazze haddome lelayla — hakkadosh baruch hu moshech alav chut shel chesed baolam habba haddome leyom, shenneemar: "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo vegomer".

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, may dichtiv: "vattaase adam kidge hayyam keremes lo moshel bo", lamma nimshelu bene adam kidge hayyam? lomar lach: ma dagim shebbayyam — kevan sheolin layyabbasha miyyad metim, af bene adam — kevan shepporshin middivre tora umin hammitzvot miyyad metim. davar acher: ma dagim shebbayyam — kevan shekkadra alehem chamma miyyad metim, kach bene adam — kevan shekkadra alehem chamma miyyad metim.

Ibbaet ema baolam hazze, veibbaet ema laolam habba. ibbaet ema baolam hazze — kidrabbi chanina, deamar rabbi chanina: hakkol bide shamayim chutz mitztzinnim pachim, shenneemar: "tzinnim pachim bederech ikkesh shomer nafsho yirchak mehem".

Veibbaet ema laolam habba — kidrabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: en gehinnam leatid lavo, ella hakkadosh baruch hu motzi chamma minnartikah, umakdir, reshaim niddonin bah, vetzaddikim mitrappein bah, reshaim niddonin

Bah, dichtiv: "[ki] hinne hayyom ba boer kattannur vehayu chol zedim vechol ose risha kash velihat otam hayyom hava amar Adonai tzevaot asher lo yaazov lahem shoresh veanaf", lo shoresh — baolam hazze, velo anaf — laolam habba.
Tzaddikim mitrappein bah, dichtiv: "vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe bichnafeha vegomer", velo od ella shemmitaddenin bah, shenneemar: "vitzatem ufishtem keegle marbek".

Davar acher: ma dagim shebbayyam — kol haggadol mechavero bolea et chavero, af bene adam — ilmale moraa shel malchut, kol haggadol mechavero bolea et chavero. vehayeynu ditnan: rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer: heve mitpallel bishlomah shel malchut, sheilmale moraah shel malchut "ish et reehu chayyim balau".

Rav chinnana bar pappa rame, ketiv: "shadday lo metzanuhu saggi choach", uchetiv: "gadol adonenu verav koach", uchetiv: "yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach"! la kashya, kan bishat haddin, kan bishat milchama.

Rabbi chama berabbi chanina rame: ketiv "chema en li", uchetiv "nokem Adonai uvaal chema"! la kashya: kan — beyisrael, kan — beummot haolam. rav chinnana bar pappa amar: "chema en li" — shekkevar nishbati, "mi yitteneni" — shello nishbati, "ehye shamir vashayit vegomer".

Vehayeynu deamar rabbi alekkesanderi: may dichtiv "vehaya bayyom hahu avakkesh lehashemid et kol haggoyim", avakkesh mimmi? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: avakkesh benigne shellahem, im yesh lahem zechut — efdem, veim lav — ashmidem.

Vehayeynu deamar rava: may dichtiv: "ach lo vei yishlach yad im befido lahen shua"? amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: kesheani dan et yisrael, en ani dan otam keummot haolam, dichtiv: "avva avva avva asimenna vegomer", ella ani nifra mehen kefid shel tarnegolet.

Davar acher: afillu en yisrael osin mitzva lefanay ki im meat, kefid shel tarnegolin shemmenakkerin baashpa, ani metzarfan lecheshbon gadol, [shenneemar: "im befido] lahen shua", [davar acher]: bassachar shemmeshavvevin lefanay, ani moshia otam.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi abba: may dichtiv "veanochi efdem vehemma dibberu alay kezavim"? ani amarti efdem bemamonam baolam hazze, kede sheyyizku laolam habba, vehemma dibberu alay kezavim.

Vehayeynu deamar rav pappi mishshemeh derava: may dichtiv "vaani yissarti chizzakti zerootam veelay yechashshevu ra"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ani amarti ayasserem beyissurin baolam hazze kede sheyyechzeku zerootam laolam habba, veelay yechashshevu ra.

Mishtabbach lehu rabbi avahu lemine berav safra, deadam gadol hu, shevaku leh michsa ditlesar shenin. yoma chad ashkechuhu, amaru leh: ketiv "rak etchem yadati mikkol mishpechot haadama al ken efkod alechem et kol avonotechem", man deit leh sisya berachameh massek leh? ishtik vela amar lehu vela midde, remo leh sudara betzavvereh veka metzaaru leh.

Ata rabbi avahu ashkechinhu, amar lehu: ammay metzaaritu leh? amaru leh: velav amrat lan deadam gadol hu? vela yada lememar lan perusha dehay pesuka! amar lehu: emar daamari lechu betannae, bikrae mi amari lechu?
Amaru leh: may shena attun deyaditun? amar lehu: anan dishchichinan gabbechon — raminan annafshin umeayyeynan, inhu la meayyeyni.

Amaru leh: lema lan at! amar lehu: emshol lachem mashal, lema haddavar dome? leadam shennoshe mishshene bene adam, echad ohavo veechad sono. ohavo — nifra mimmennu meat meat, sono — nifra mimmennu bevat achat.

Amar rabbi abba bar kahana: may dichtiv "chalila lecha measot kaddavar hazze lehamit tzaddik im rasha"? amar avraham lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, chullin hu measot kaddavar hazze lehamit tzaddik im rasha.
Vela? vehachtiv: "vehichratti mimmech tzaddik verasha"! betzaddik sheeno gamur.

Aval betzaddik gamur la? vehachtiv "umimmikdashi tachellu", vetane rav yosef: al tikre "mimmikdashi" ella "mimmekuddashay", ellu bene adam shekkiyyeymu et hattora mealef vead tav. hatam name, kevan shehaya beyadam limchot velo michu, havu lehu ketzaddikim sheenan gemurim.
Rav pappa rame, ketiv: "el zoem bechol yom", uchetiv: "lifne zamo mi yaamod"! la kashya, kan beyachid, kan betzibbur.

Tanu rabbanan: "el zoem bechol yom", vechamma zamo? rega. vechamma rega? achat mechamesh ribbo usheloshet alafim ushemone meot vearbaim ushemone beshaa, zo hi rega, veen kol beriyya yechola lechavven otah rega chutz mibbilam harasha, dichtiv beh:
"Veyodea daat elyon" — efshar daat behemto la hava yada, daat elyon mi hava yada?

May "daat behemto la hava yada"? beiddana dachazo leh dahava rechiv achamareh, amaru leh: may tama la rechavta assuseya? amar lehu: birtiva sheday leh. miyyad: "vattomer haaton halo anochi atoncha", amar la: litina bealma.

Amara leh: "asher rachavta alay"! amar la: akray bealma. amara leh: "meodcha vead hayyom hazze", velo od ella sheani osa lach rechivut bayyom veishut ballayla. ketiv hacha: "hahasken hiskanti", uchetiv hatam: "vattehi lo sochenet".

Ella may "veyodea daat elyon"? shehaya yodea lechavven otah shaa shehakkadosh baruch hu koes bah, vehayeynu dekaamar lehu navi: "ammi zechor na ma yaatz balak melech moav ume ana oto bilam ben beor min hashshittim vead haggilgal lemaan daat tzidkot Adonai".

Amar rabbi elazar, amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: ammi, reu kamma tzedakot asiti immachem shello kaasti alechem kol otan hayyamim, sheim kaasti alechem lo nishtayyer missonehem shel yisrael sarid ufalit, vehayeynu dekaamar leh bilam levalak: "ma ekkov lo kabbo el uma ezom lo zoem Adonai".

Vechamma zamo? rega. vechamma rega? amar ammemar, veittema ravina: rega kememreh. umenalan derega hava ritcheh? dichtiv: "ki rega beappo chayyim birtzono". veibbaet ema mehacha: "chavi kimat rega ad yaavor zaam".
Emat ratach? amar abbaye: bitlat shae kammayayta, ki chivvara karbalta detarnegola. kol shata veshata michvavr chayvra? kol shata it beh sureyayke summake, hahi shata let beh sureyayke summake.
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi hava metzaer leh hahu mina [bikrae], yoma chad nekat tarnegola [veokmeh ben kareh dearsa], veayyen beh, sevar: ki mata hahi shata elteh, ki meta hahi shata naymnem.
Amar: shema minna lav orach ara lemibad hachi, ["verachamav al kol maasav"] ketiv, uchetiv: "gam anosh latztzaddik lo tov".

Tana mishshemeh derabbi meir: beshaa shehammelachim mannichin kitrehen berashehen umishtachavin lachamma, miyyad koes [hakkadosh baruch hu]. amar rav yosef: la litzalle inish tzelota demusafe bitlat shae kammayayta deyoma beyoma kamma deresh shatta beyachid, dilma kevan demippekid dina, dilma meayyeyni beovadeh vedachafu leh middeche.
I hachi, detzibbur name! detzibbur nefisha zechuteh. i hachi, deyachid detzafra name la! kevan deikka tzibbura deka metzallu, la ka middeche.
Veha amrat: shalosh rishonot hakkadosh baruch hu yoshev veosek battora! efoch.

Veibbaet ema: leolam la tefoch, tora dichtiv ba "emet", dichtiv: "emet kene veal timkor" — en hakkadosh baruch hu ose lifnim mishshurat haddin, din dela ketiv beh "emet" — hakkadosh baruch hu ose lifnim mishshurat haddin.

(Yom, meid, taraf, baegel — siman.) gufa, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv "asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom laasotam"? "hayyom laasotam" — velo lemachar laasotam, "hayyom laasotam" — velo hayyom littol secharan.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol mitzvot sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze, baot umeidot otam laolam habba, shenneemar: "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku yishmeu veyomru emet". "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku" — ellu yisrael, "yishmeu veyomru emet" — ellu ummot haolam.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol mitzvot sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze, baot vetorfot otam leummot haolam laolam habba al penehem, shenneemar: "ushemartem vaasitem ki hiv chochmatchem uvinatchem leene haammim", "neged haammim" lo neemar, ella "leene haammim", melammed shebbaot vetorfot leummot haolam al penehem laolam habba.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lo asu yisrael et haegel ella litten pitchon pe levaale teshuva, shenneemar: "mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem leyira oti kol hayyamim vegomer".
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: lo david rauy leoto maase, velo yisrael reuyin leoto maase, lo david rauy leoto maase, dichtiv: "velibbi chalal bekirbi",
Velo yisrael reuyin leoto maase, dichtiv: "mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem leyira oti kol hayyamim", ella lama asu?
Lomar lach, sheim chata yachid — omrim lo: kelach etzel yachid, veim chatu tzibbur — omrim lo: kelach etzel tzibbur.

Utzericha, dei ashmoinan yachid — mishshum dela mefarsam chiteh, aval tzibbur dimfarsam chitayhu — ema la. vei ashmoinan tzibbur — mishshum dinfishi rachamayyhu, aval yachid dela allima zechuteh — ema la, tzericha.
Vehayeynu derabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan, may dichtiv "neum david ben yishay uneum haggever hukam al"? neum david ben yishay shehekim ullah shel teshuva.

Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol haose mitzva achat baolam hazze, mekaddamto veholechet lefanav laolam habba, shenneemar: "vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha uchevod Adonai yaasfecha", vechol haover avera achat, melappafto umolichato leyom haddin, shenneemar: "yillaftu orchot darkam vegomer".
Rabbi elazar omer: keshura bo kechelev, shenneemar: "velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihyot immah", "lishkav etzlah" — baolam hazze, "lihyot immah" — baolam habba.
Bekhorot 24a:4-12: May barayyta? detanya: hallokeach behema menika min haggoy, habba acharav bechor missafek, mippene shemmerachemet af al pi sheenah yoledet. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: davar bechezkato.

Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hannichnas letoch edro ballayla veraa keeser kachamesh esre, mavkirot vesheenan mavkirot, yoldot, lemachar hishkim umatza zecharim (teluyot) [teluyin] besheen mavkirot, unekevot teluyot bemavkirot — eno choshesh shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo.
Ibbaya lehu: davar bechezkato dekaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel, deenah merachemet ella im ken yoledet — ha hecha deolid chayyshinan lerachome, o dilma: dida merachama, dela dida la merachama leh?
Lemay nafka minna? lemilke ala mishshum "oto veet beno". i amrat dida merachama, dela dida la merachama — lake, vei amrat dela dida name merachama — la lake.

May? ta shema, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hallokeach behema min haggoy — eno choshesh shemma benah shel acheret haya. mi katane "hu"? "haya" katane! hachi kaamar: eno choshesh shemma benah shel acheret, ella im ken haya lah valad meikkara.
Ta shema: nichnas betoch edro veraa et hammavkirot menikot, veet sheenan mavkirot menikot — eno choshesh shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo, o shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo.
Ammay? lechush dilma rachome rachem! bimkom dida, la shavka dida umerachama dela dida.
Ta shema: davar bechezkato kulei. may lav resha dumeya desefa? ma sefa vadday dida, af resha vadday dida.
Midde irya? hay kidite, vehay kidite. umay "vechen"? appetura divchora.
Berakhot 46a:1-6: Rabbi zera chalash, al legabbeh rabbi avahu, kabbel aleh: i mittefach kattina charich shake — avedna yoma tava lerabbanan. ittefach, avad seodta lechullehu rabbanan. ki meta lemishre amar leh lerabbi zera: lishre lan mar. amar leh: la savar la mar leha derabbi yochanan deamar: baal habbayit botzea? shera lehu.
Ki meta levaroche, amar leh: nevarech lan mar. amar leh: la savar la mar leha derav huna demin bavel deamar: botzea mevarech?

Ki ha deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: baal habbayit botzea, veoreach mevarech. baal habbayit botzea — kede sheyyivtza beayin yafa. veoreach mevarech — kede sheyyevarech baal habbayit.
May mevarech — "yehi ratzon shello yevosh baal habbayit baolam hazze, velo yikkalem leolam habba".

Verabbi mosif bah devarim: "veyitzlach meod bechol nechasav, veyihyu nechasav unechasenu mutzelachim ukerovim lair, veal yishlot satan lo bemaase yadav velo bemaase yadenu, veal yizdakker lo lefanav velo lefanenu shum devar hirhur chet vaavera veavon meatta vead olam".
Gittin 90a:10-90b:7: Rabbi akiva omer: afillu matza acheret: bemay ka mippalgi? bidresh lakish – deamar resh lakish: "ki" meshammesh bearbaa leshonot – i, dilma, ella, deha.
Bet shammay savri: "vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav, ki matza vah ervat davar" – deha matza vah ervat davar; verabbi akiva savar: "ki matza vah ervat davar" – i name, matza vah ervat davar.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: lo matza bah lo erva velo davar, mahu?
Amar leh, middegalli rachamana gabbe ones: "lo yuchal leshallechah kol yamav" – kol yamav baamod vehachezer" kae; hatam hu degalli rachamana, aval hacha – may daavad avad.
Amar leh rav mesharsheya lerava: im libbo legarshah, vehi yoshevet tachtav umeshammashto, mahu? kare aleh: "al tacharosh al reacha raa vehu yoshev lavetach ittach".

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: keshem shehaddeot bemaachol, kach deot benashim. yesh lecha adam shezzevuv nofel letoch koso – vezorko, veeno shotehu; vezo hi middat pappus ben yehuda, shehaya noel bifne ishto veyotze.
Veyesh lecha adam shezzevuv nofel letoch koso – vezorko, veshotehu; vezo hi middat kol adam, shemmedabberet im acheha ukeroveha – umannichah.
Veyesh lecha adam shezzevuv nofel letoch tamchuy – motztzo, veochlo; zo hi middat adam ra, sheroe et ishto yotza veroshah parua, vetova bashshuk,
Uferuma mishshene tzedadeha, verochetzet im bene adam.
"Im bene adam" salka datach?! ella bimkom shebbene adam rochatzin.

Zo – mitzva min hattora legarshah, shenneemar: "ki matza vah ervat vegomer veshillechah mibbeto". "vehalcha vehayta leish acher" – hakkatuv kerao "acher", lomar: sheen ze ben zugo larishon – ze hotzi reshaa mibbeto, veze hichnis reshaa letoch beto.

Zacha sheni – shillechah, shenneemar: "useneah haish haacharon". veim lav – kovarto, shenneemar: "o chi yamut haish haacharon" – keday hu bemita; shezze hotzi reshaa mibbeto, veze hichnis reshaa letoch beto.
"Ki sane shallach" – rabbi yehuda omer: im senetah – shallach. rabbi yochanan omer: sanouy hameshalleach.
Vela peligi: ha bezug rishon, ha bezug sheni.

Deamar rabbi elazar: kol hamegaresh ishto rishona – afillu mizbeach morid alav demaot, shenneemar: "vezot shenit taasu, kassot dima et mizbach Adonai, bechi vaanaka meen od penot el hammincha, velakachat ratzon miyyedchem. vaamartem: al ma? al ki Adonai heid bencha uven eshet neurecha, asher atta bagadta bah, vehi chavertecha veeshet beritecha".
Joshua 13:15-20: Vayhi lahem haggevul mearoer asher al-sefat-nachal arnon vehair asher betoch-hannachal vechol-hammishor al-medva
Cheshbon vechol-areha asher bammishor divon uvamot baal uvet baal meon
Vekiryatayim vesivma vetzeret hashshachar behar haemek
Uvet peor veashdot happisga uvet hayeshimot
Joshua 13:21-24: Vechol are hammishor vechol-mamlechut sichon melech haemori asher malach becheshbon asher hikka moshe oto ׀ veet-nesie midyan et-evi veet-rekem veet-tzur veet-chur veet-reva nesiche sichon yoshve haaretz
Veet-bilam ben-beor hakkosem hargu vene-yisrael bacherev el-challehem
Vayhi gevul bene reuven hayyarden ugevul zot nachalat bene-reuven lemishpechotam hearim vechatzrehen {p}
Joshua 13:25-29: Vayhi lahem haggevul yazer vechol-are haggilad vachatzi eretz bene ammon ad-aroer asher al-pene rabba
Umecheshbon ad-ramat hammitzpe uvetonim umimmachanayim ad-gevul lidvir
Uvaemek bet haram uvet nimra vesukkot vetzafon yeter mamlechut sichon melech cheshbon hayyarden ugevul ad-ketze yam-kinneret ever hayyarden mizracha
Zot nachalat bene-gad lemishpechotam hearim vechatzrehem {s}
Vayyitten moshe lachatzi shevet menashshe vayhi lachatzi matte vene-menashshe lemishpechotam
Joshua 13:30-14:2: Vayhi gevulam mimmachanayim kol-habbashan kol-mamlechut ׀ og melech-habbashan vechol-chavvot yair asher babbashan shishshim ir
Vachatzi haggilad veashtarot veedrei are mamlechut og babbashan livne machir ben-menashshe lachatzi vene-machir lemishpechotam
Elle asher-nichal moshe bearvot moav meever leyarden yericho mizracha {p}
Uleshevet hallevi lo-natan moshe nachala Adonai elohe yisrael hu nachalatam kaasher dibber lahem {s}
Veelle asher-nachalu vene-yisrael beeretz kenaan asher nichalu otam elazar hakkohen vihoshua bin-nun verashe avot hammattot livne yisrael
Begoral nachalatam kaasher tzivva Adonai beyad-moshe letishat hammattot vachatzi hammatte
Joshua 14:3-7: Ki-natan moshe nachalat shene hammattot vachatzi hammatte meever layyarden velalviyyim lo-natan nachala betocham
Ki-hayu vene-yosef shene mattot menashshe veefrayim velo-natnu chelek lalviyyim baaretz ki im-arim lashevet umigreshehem lemiknehem ulekinyanam
Kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe ken asu bene yisrael vayyachleku et-haaretz {p}
Vayyiggeshu vene-yehuda el-yehoshua baggilgal vayyomer elav kalev ben-yefunne hakkenizzi atta yadata et-haddavar asher-dibber Adonai el-moshe ish-haelohim al odotay veal odotecha bekadesh barnea
Ben-arbaim shana anochi bishloach moshe eved-Adonai oti mikkadesh barnea leraggel et-haaretz vaashev oto davar kaasher im-levavi
Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:12-5:3:
Hammetaher yeno shel nachri venotno virshuto, vehalla chotev lo, hitkabbalti mimmecha maot, muttar. aval im yirtze yisrael lehotzio veeno mannicho ad sheyyitten lo et meotav, ze haya maase vevet shean, veasru chachamim: 
Hassocher et happoel laasot immo veyen nesech, secharo asur. secharo laasot immo melacha acheret, af al pi sheamar lo haaver li chavit shel yen nesech mimmakom lemakom, secharo muttar. hasocher et hachamor lehavi aleha yen nesech, secharah asur. secharah leshev aleha, af al pi shehinniach haggoy legino aleha, secharah muttar: 
Yen nesech shennafal al gabbe anavim, yedichen vehen muttarot. veim hayu mevukkaot, asurot. nafal al gabbe teenim o al gabbe temarim, im yesh bahen benoten taam, asur. maase bevaytos ben zonan shehevi gerogarot bisfina, venishtabbera chavit shel yen nesech venafal al gabbehen, veshaal lachachamim vehittirum. ze hakkelal, kol shebbahanaato benoten taam, asur. kol sheen bahanaato benoten taam, muttar, kegon chometz shennafal al gabbe gerisin: 
Nachri shehaya maavir im yisrael kadde yayin mimmakom lemakom, im haya vechezkat hammishtammer, muttar. im hodio shehu maflig, kede sheyyishtom veyistom veyiggov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kede sheyyiftach veyaguf vetiggov:
Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:4-7:
Hammanniach yeno vekaron o visfina vehalach lo vekappandarya, nichnas lammedina verachatz, muttar. im hodio shehu maflig, kede sheyyishtom veyistom veyiggov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kede sheyyiftach veyaguf vetiggov. hammanniach nachri vachanut, af al pi shehu yotze venichnas, muttar. veim hodio shehu maflig, kede sheyishtom veyistom veyiggov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kede sheyyiftach veyaguf vetiggov: 
Haya ochel immo al hashshulchan vehinniach legina al hashshulchan, ulegina al haddulbeki, vehinnicho veyatza, ma sheal hashshulchan, asur. uma sheal haddulbeki, muttar. veim amar lo heve mozeg veshote, af sheal haddulbeki asur. chaviyyot petuchot, asurot. setumot, kede sheyyiftach veyaguf vetiggov: 
Balleshet goyim shennichnesa lair bishat shalom, chaviyyot petuchot, asurot. setumot, muttarot. bishat milchama, ellu vaellu muttarot, lefi sheen penay lenassech: 
Ummanin shel yisrael sheshshalach lahem nachri chavit shel yen nesech bischaran, muttarim lomar lo ten lanu et dameha. veim mishshennichnesa lirshutan, asur. hammocher yeno lannachri, pasak ad shello madad, damav muttarin. madad ad shello fasak, damav asurin. natal et hammashpech umadad letoch tzelochito shel nachri, vechazar umadad letoch tzelochito shel yisrael, im yesh bo akkevet yayin, asur. hameare mikkeli el keli, et sheera mimmennu, muttar. veet sheera letocho, asur:
Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:8-12:
Yen nesech asur, veoser bechol shehu. yayin beyayin umayim bemayim, bechol shehu. yayin bemayim umayim beyayin, benoten taam. ze hakkelal, min bemino, bemashshehu. veshello vemino, benoten taam: 
Ellu asurin, veosrin bechol shehen. yen nesech, vaavoda zara, veorot levuvin, veshor hanniskal, veegla arufa, vetzippore metzora, usear nazir, ufeter chamor, uvasar bechalav, vesair hammishtalleach, vechullin shennishchatu vaazara, hare ellu asurin veosrin bechol shehen: 
Yen nesech shennafal levor, kullo asur bahanaa. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, yimmacher kullo lenachri, chutz middeme yen nesech shebbo: 
Gat shel even shezzippetah goy, menaggevah vehi tehora. veshel etz, rabbi omer, yenaggev. vachachamim omrim, yiklof et hazzefet. veshel cheres, af al pi shekkalaf et hazzefet, hare zo asura: 
Hallokeach kele tashmish min haggoy, et sheddarko lehatebil, yatbil. lehageil, yagil. lelabben baur, yelabben baur. hashshappud vehaaskela, melabbenan baur. hassakkin, shafah vehi tehora:
Mishnah Mikvaot 1:1: Shesh maalot bammikvaot, zo lemala mizzo, vezo lemala mizzo. me gevaim, shata tame veshata tahor, tame. shata tame umille vichli tahor, tame. shata tame venafal kikkar shel teruma, im hediach, tame. veim lo hediach, tahor:
Mishnah Tahorot 10:1-5:
Hannoel bet habbad mippene habbaddadin vehayu lesham kelim temein midras, rabbi meir omer, bet habbad tame. rabbi yehuda omer, bet habbad tahor. rabbi shimon omer, im tehorin lahen, bet habbad tame. veim temein lahen, bet habbad tahor. amar rabbi yose, vechi mippene ma temeot, ella sheen amme haaretz bekiin behesset: 
Habbaddadin shehayu nichnasin veyotzin, umashkin temein betoch bet habbad, im yesh ben mashkin lazzetim kede sheyyenaggevu et raglehem baaretz, hare ellu tehorin. habbaddadin vehabbotzrin shennimtzet tuma lifnehem, neemanin lomar lo naganu. vechen hattinokot shebbenehem, yotzim chutz lefetach bet habbad ufonin laachore haggader, vehen tehorin. ad kamma yarchiku veyihyu tehorin, ad kede sheyyehe roan: 
Habbaddadin vehabbotzrin, kevan shehichnisan lirshut hammeara, dayyo, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, tzarich laamod alehen ad sheyyitbolu. rabbi shimon omer, im tehorin lahen, tzarich laamod alehem ad sheyyitbolu. im temeim lahen, eno tzarich laamod alehem ad sheyyitbolu: 
Hannoten min hassallim umin hammashteach shel adama, bet shammay omrim, noten beyadayim tehorot. veim natan beyadayim temeot, timmean. bet hillel omrim, noten beyadayim temeot, umafrish terumato betohora. min haavat umin hammashteach shel alim, hakkol shavim shehu noten beyadayim tehorot. veim natan beyadayim temeot, timmean: 
Haochel min hassallim umin hammashteach shel adama, af al pi shemmevukkaot umenattefot laggat, hare haggat tehora. min haavat umin hammashteach shel alim venafal mimmennu garger yechidi, im yesh lo chotam, tahor. im en lo chotam, tame. naflu mimmennu anavim uderachan bemakom hammufne, kabbetza mechuvvan, tahor. yoter mikkabbetza, tame, shekkevan sheyyatzat tippa harishona, nitmet bechabbetza:
Mishnah Tahorot 10:6-8:
Mi shehaya omed umedabber al sefat habbor venitteza tzinnora mippiv, safek higgia labbor safek lo higgia, sefeko tahor: 
Hazzolef et habbor, nimtza sheretz barishona, kullan temeot. baacharona, hi temea vechullan tehorot. ematay, bizman shehu zolef bechol achat veachat. aval im haya zolef bemachatz, nimtza sheretz beachat mehen, hi temea bilvad. ematay, bizman shehu vodek velo mechasse o mechasse velo vodek. haya vodek umechasse, venimtza sheretz, bechavit, hakkol tame. babbor, hakkol tame. bammachatz, hakkol tame: 
Ben haiggulim lazzaggin, reshut harabbim. kerem shellifne habbotzrim, reshut hayyachid. shelleachar habbotzrim, reshut harabbim. ematay, bizman sheharabbim nichnasim bazo veyotzim bazo. kele vet habbad, veshel gat, vehaekel, bizman shehen shel etz, menaggevan vehen tehorin. bizman shehen shel gemi, meyashshenan kol shenem asar chodesh, o choltan bechammim. rabbi yose omer, im netanan beshibbolet hannahar, dayyo:
Mishnah Tahorot 8:2-5:
Hammafkid kelim etzel am haaretz, temeim teme met utemein midras. im makkiro shehu ochel batteruma, tehorin mitteme met, aval temein midras. rabbi yose omer, im masar lo teva melea vegadim, bizman shehi rotzetzet, temein midras. im enah rotzetzet, temein maddaf, af al pi shehammafteach beyad habbealim: 
Hameabbed bayyom umatza vayyom, tahor. bayyom umatza vallayla, ballayla umatza vayyom, bayyom umatza vayyom shelleacharav, tame. ze hakkelal, kol sheyyaavor alav hallayla o miktzato, tame. hashshoteach kelim, birshut harabbim, tehorin. uvirshut hayyachid, temein. veim haya meshammeran, tehorim. naflu vehalach lahavian, temeim. nafal dalyo letoch boro shel am haaretz vehalach lehavi vema yaalennu, tame, mippene shehunnach birshut am haaretz shaa echat: 
Hammanniach et beto fatuach umetzao fatuach, naul umetzao naul, patuach umetzao naul, tahor. naul umetzao fatuach, rabbi meir metamme, vachachamim metaharin, shehayu gannavim venimlechu vehalchu lahen: 
Eshet am haaretz shennichnesa letoch beto shel chaver lehotzi veno o vitto o vehemto, habbayit tahor, mippene shennichnesa shello virshut:
Mishnah Tahorot 8:6-9:1:
Kelal amru vattohorot, kol hameyuchad leochel adam, tame, ad sheyyippasel meochel hakkelev. vechol sheeno meyuchad leochel adam, tahor, ad sheyyeyachadennu leadam. ketzad. gozal shennafal legat vechishshav alav lehaaloto lenachri, tame. lechelev, tahor. rabbi yochanan ben nuri metamme. chishshav alav cheresh, shote vekatan, tahor. im heelahu, tame, sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava: 
Achore chelim shennitmeu vemashkim, rabbi eliezer omer, metammein et hammashkin veen poslin et hoochalin. rabbi yehoshua omer, metammein et hammashkin ufoslin et hoochalin. shimon achi azarya omer, lo chach velo chach, ella mashkin shennitmeu vaachore hakkelim, metammein echad ufoslin echad. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni, veatta timmetani: 
Areva shehi ketafres, vehabbatzek millemalan umashke tofeach millemattan, shalosh chatichot bechabbetza, enan mitztarfot. ushetayim, mitztarfot. rabbi yose omer, af shetayim enan mitztarfot, ella im ken hayu rotztzot mashke. veim haya mashke omed, afillu cheen hachardal, mitztaref. rabbi dosa omer, ochel parud eno mitztaref: 
Makkel shehi melea mashkin temein, kevan shehishshikah lammikve, tehora, divre rabbi yehoshua. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyatbil et kullah. hannitztzok vehakketafres umashke tofeach, enan chibbur lo lattuma velo lattohora. vehaeshboren, chibbur lattuma velattohora: 
Zetim meematay mekabbelin tuma. mishsheyyazziu zeat hammaatan, aval lo zeat hakkuppa, kedivre vet shammay. rabbi shimon omer, shiur zea shelosha yamim. bet hillel omrim, mishsheyyitchabberu shelosha ze laze. rabban gamliel omer, mishshettiggamer melachtan. vachachamim omrim kidvarav:
Mishnah Tahorot 9:2-5:
Gamar millimsok aval atid likkach, gamar millikkach aval atid lilvot, ero evel, o mishte, o ones, afillu zavim vezavot mehallechim alehen, tehorin. naflu alehen mashkin temein, en tame ella mekom maggaan, vehammochal hayyotze mehen tahor: 
Nigmera melachtan, hare ellu muchsharin. naflu alehen mashkin, temein. hammochal hayyotze mehen, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein. amar rabbi shimon, lo nechleku al hammochal hayyotze min hazzetim, shehu tahor. veal ma nechleku. al hayyotze min habbor, sherabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein: 
Haggomer et zetav veshiyyer kuppa achat, yittenenna leani hakkohen, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, yolich et hammafteach miyyad. rabbi shimon omer, meet leet: 
Hammanniach zetim bakkotesh sheyyimtonu sheyyehu nochin lichtosh, hare ellu muchsharim. sheyyimtonu sheyyimlachem, bet shammay omrim, muchsharim. uvet hillel omrim, enan muchsharim. happotzea zetim beyadayim temeot, timmean:
Mishnah Tahorot 9:6-9:
Hammanniach zetav baggag legargeram, afillu hen rum amma, enan muchsharim. netanan babbayit sheyyilku veatid lehaalotam laggag, netanan baggag sheyyilku o sheyyiftechem, hare ellu muchsharin. netanan babbayit ad sheyyeshammer et gaggo o ad sheyyolichem lemakom acher, enan muchsharin: 
Ratza littol mehen bad echad o shene vaddin, bet shammay omrim, kotze vetuma umechappe vetohora. bet hillel omrim, af mechappe vetuma. rabbi yose omer, chofer bekardummot shel mattechet umolich levet habbad betuma: 
Hashsheretz shennimtza varechayim, en tame ella mekom maggao. im haya mashke mehallech, hakkol tame. nimtza al gabbe healim, yishshaalu habbaddadim lomar lo naganu. im haya nogea baom, afillu vesaara, tame: 
Nimtza al gabbe ferudim, vehu nogea bechabbetza, tame. perudim al gabbe ferudim, af al pi shehu nogea bechabbetza, en tame ella mekom maggao. nimtza ven kotel lazzetim, tahor. nimtza vaggag, hammaatan tahor. nimtza vammaatan, haggag tame. nimtza saruf al hazzetim, vechen matlit mehuha, tehora, shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan:
Mishnah Yoma 4:4-5:2:
Bechol yom haya chote beshel kesef umeare vetoch shel zahav, vehayyom chote veshel zahav uvah haya machnis. bechol yom chote veshel arbaat kabbin umeare vetoch shel sheloshet kabbin, vehayyom chote veshel sheloshet kabbin, uvah haya machnis. rabbi yose omer, bechol yom chote veshel sea umeare vetoch shel sheloshet kabbin, vehayyom chote veshel sheloshet kabbin, uvah haya machnis. bechol yom hayta cheveda, vehayyom kalla. bechol yom hayta yadah ketzara, vehayyom arukka. bechol yom haya zehavah yarok, vehayyom adom, divre rabbi menachem. bechol yom makriv peras beshacharit uferas ben haarbayim, vehayyom mosif melo chafnav. bechol yom hayta dakka, vehayyom dakka min haddakka: 
Bechol yom kohanim olim bemizracho shel kevesh veyordin bemaaravo, vehayyom kohen gadol ole vaemtza veyored baemtza. rabbi yehuda omer, leolam kohen gadol ole vaemtza veyored baemtza. bechol yom kohen gadol mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiyyor, vehayyom min hakkiton shel zahav. rabbi yehuda omer, leolam kohen gadol mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiton shel zahav: 
Bechol yom hayu sham arba maarachot, vehayyom chamesh, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, bechol yom shalosh, vehayyom arba. rabbi yehuda omer, bechol yom shetayim, vehayyom shalosh: 
Hotziu lo et hakkaf veet hammachta, vechafan melo chafnav venatan letoch hakkaf, haggadol lefi gadlo, vehakkatan lefi katno, vechach hayta middatah. natal et hammachta bimino veet hakkaf bismolo. haya mehallech bahechol, ad shemmaggia leven shete happarochot hammavdilot ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim, uvenehen amma. rabbi yose omer, lo hayta sham ella farochet achat bilvad, shenneemar (Shemot 26), vehivdila happarochet lachem ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim. hachitzona hayta ferufa min haddarom, vehappenimit min hatztzafon. mehallech benehen, ad shemmaggia latztzafon. higgia latztzafon, hofech panav laddarom, mehallech lismolo im happarochet ad shehu maggia laaron. higgia laaron. noten et hammachta ben shene habbaddim. tzavar et hakketoret al gabbe gechalim, venitmalle chol habbayit kullo ashan. yatza uva lo vederech bet kenisato, umitpallel tefilla ketzara babbayit hachitzon, velo haya maarich bitfillato, shello lehaveit et yisrael: 
Mishshennittal haaron, even hayta sham mimot neviim rishonim, ushetiyya hayta nikret, gevoha min haaretz shalosh etzbaot, vealeha haya noten:
Mishnah Yoma 5:3-6:
Natal et haddam mimmi shehaya memares bo, nichnas lammakom shennichnas, veamad bammakom sheamad, vehizza mimmennu achat lemala vesheva lematta, velo haya mitkavven lehazzot lo lemala velo lematta, ella chematzlif. vechach haya mone, achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim, achat veshalosh, achat vearba, achat vechamesh, achat vashesh, achat vasheva. yatza vehinnicho al kan hazzahav shebbahechol: 
Heviu lo et hassair, shechato vekibbel bammizrak et damo. nichnas limkom shennichnas, veamad bimkom sheamad, vehizza mimmennu achat lemala vesheva lematta, velo haya mitkavven lehazzot lo lemala velo lematta, ella chematzlif. vechach haya mone, achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim, achat veshalosh, achat vearba, achat vechamesh, achat vashesh, achat vasheva. yatza vehinnicho al kan hashsheni shehaya vahechol. rabbi yehuda omer, lo haya sham ella kan echad bilvad. natal dam happar vehinniach dam hassair, vehizza mimmennu al happarochet shekkeneged haaron mibbachutz, achat lemala vesheva lematta, velo haya mitkavven lehazzot lo lemala velo lematta, ella chematzlif. vechach haya mone, achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim, achat veshalosh, achat vearba, achat vechamesh, achat vashesh, achat vasheva. natal dam hassair vehinniach dam happar, vehizza mimmennu al happarochet shekkeneged haaron mibbachutz, achat lemala vesheva lematta, velo haya mitkavven lehazzot lo lemala velo lematta, ella chematzlif. vechach haya mone, achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim, achat veshalosh, achat vearba, achat vechamesh, achat vashesh, achat vasheva. era dam happar letoch dam hassair, venatan et hammale varekan: 
Veyatza el hammizbeach asher lifne Adonai, ze mizbach hazzahav. hitchil mechatte veyored. mehechan hu matchil, mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit, deromit mizrachit. mekom shehu matchil bachattat al mizbeach hachitzon, mishsham haya gomer al mizbeach happenimi. rabbi eliezer omer, bimkomo haya omed umechatte. veal kullan haya noten millematta lemala, chutz mizzo shehayta lefanav, shealeha haya noten milmala lematta: 
Hizza al tohoro shel mizbeach sheva peamim, usheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon, veshel mizbeach hachitzon haya shofech al yesod deromi. ellu vaellu mitarvin baamma veyotzin lenachal kidron, venimkarin laggannanin lezevel, umoalin bahen:
Mishnah Yoma 5:7-6:3:
Kol maase yom hakkippurim haamur al hasseder, im hikdim maase lachavero, lo asa chelum. hikdim dam hassair ledam happar, yachazor veyazze middam hassair leachar dam happar. veim ad shello gamar et hammattanot shebbifnim nishpach haddam, yavi dam acher veyachazor veyazze vattechilla bifnim. vechen bahechol, vechen bemizbach hazzahav, shekkullan kappara vifne atzman. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim, mimmekom sheppasak, mishsham hu matchil: 
Shene seire yom hakkippurim, mitzvatan sheyyihyu shenehen shavin bemare uvekoma uvedamim uvilkichatan keechad. veaf al pi sheenan shavin, kesherin. lakach echad hayyom veechad lemachar, kesherin. met echad mehen, im ad shello higril met, yikkach zug lashsheni. veim mishshehigril met, yavi zug acher veyagril alehem battechilla, veyomar, im shel shem met, ze sheala alav haggoral lashshem yitkayyem tachtav. veim shel azazel met, ze sheala alav haggoral laazazel yitkayyem tachtav. vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava, sheen chattat tzibbur meta. rabbi yehuda omer, tamut. veod amar rabbi yehuda, nishpach haddam, yamut hammishtalleach. met hammishtalleach, yishshafech haddam: 
Ba lo etzel sair hammishtalleach vesomech shete yadav alav umitvadde. vechach haya omer, anna hashshem, avu pashu chatu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael. anna bashshem, kapper na laavonot velappeshaim velachataim, sheavu vesheppashu veshechatu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael, kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha lemor (Vayikra 16), ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu. vehakkohanim vehaam haomdim baazara, keshehayu shomim shem hameforash shehu yotze mippi chohen gadol, hayu korim umishtachavim venoflim al penehem, veomrim, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed: 
Mesaro lemi shehaya molicho. hakkol kesherin leholicho, ella sheasu hakkohanim gedolim keva velo hayu mannichin et yisrael leholicho. amar rabbi yose, maase veholicho arsela, veyisrael haya:
Mishnah Yoma 6:4-8:
Vechevesh asu lo mippene habbavliyyim, shehayu metalleshim bisaro, veomrim lo, tol vatze, tol vatze. miyyakkire yerushalayim hayu melavvin oto ad sukka harishona. eser sukkot mirushalayim vead tzuk, tishim ris, shiva umechetza lechol mil: 
Al kol sukka vesukka omrim lo, hare mazon vahare mayim. umelavvin oto missukka lesukka, chutz meacharona shebbahen, sheeno maggia immo latztzuk, ella omed merachok veroe et maasav: 
Me haya ose, cholek lashon shel zehorit, chetzyo kashar bassela vechetzyo kashar ben shete karnav, udechafo laachorav, vehu mitgalgel veyored, velo haya maggia lachatzi hahar ad shennaasa evarim evarim. ba veyashav lo tachat sukka acharona ad shettechshach. umeematay metamme vegadim, mishsheyyetze chutz lechomat yerushalayim. rabbi shimon omer, mishsheat dechiyyato latztzuk: 
Ba lo etzel par vesair hannisrafin. keraan vehotzi et emurehen, netanan bemages, vehiktiran al gabbe hammizbeach. kelaan bemiklaot, vehotzian levet hasserefa. umeematay metammein begadim, mishsheyyetzu chutz lechomat haazara. rabbi shimon omer, mishsheyyitztzat haur berubban: 
Amru lo lechohen gadol, higgia sair lammidbar. uminnayin hayu yodin shehiggia sair lammidbar, darkiyyot hayu osin, umenifin bassudarin, veyodin shehiggia sair lammidbar. amar rabbi yehuda, vahalo siman gadol haya lahem, mirushalayim vead bet chiddudo shelosha milin. holchin mil, vechozrin mil, veshohin kede mil, veyodin shehiggia sair lammidbar. rabbi yishmael omer, vahalo siman acher haya lahem, lashon shel zehorit haya kashur al pitcho shel hechol, ucheshehiggia sair lammidbar haya hallashon malbin, shenneemar (yeshaya 1), im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu:
Mishnah Yoma 7:1-4:
Ba lo chohen gadol likrot. im ratza likrot bevigde vutz, kore. veim lo, kore veitztelit lavan mishshello. chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotno lerosh hakkeneset, verosh hakkeneset notno lassegan, vehassegan notno lechohen gadol, vechohen gadol omed umekabbel vekore omed, vekore achare mot veach beasor. vegolel sefer tora umannicho vecheko, veomer, yoter mimma shekkarati lifnechem katuv kan, uveasor shebbechummash happekudim kore al pe, umevarech aleha shemone verachot, al hattora, veal haavoda, veal hahodaa, veal mechilat heavon, veal hammikdash bifne atzmo, veal yisrael bifne atzman veal yerushalayim bifne atzmah veal hakkohanim bifne atzman veal shear hattefilla: 
Haroe chohen gadol keshehu kore, eno roe far vesair hannisrafim. veharoe far vesair hannisrafim, eno roe chohen gadol keshehu kore. velo mippene sheeno rashshay, ella shehayta derech rechoka, umelechet shenehen shava cheechat: 
Im bevigde vutz kore, kiddesh yadav veraglav, pashat yarad vetaval, ala venistappeg. heviu lo vigde zahav, velavash, vekiddesh yadav veraglav, veyatza veasa et elo veet el haam, veet shivat kevasim temimim bene shana, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi akiva omer, im tamid shel shachar hayu kerevin, ufar haola vesair hannaase vachutz hayu kerevin im tamid shel ben haarbayim: 
Kiddesh yadav veraglav, ufashat veyarad vetaval veala venistappeg. heviu lo vigde lavan, velavash, vekiddesh yadav veraglav. nichnas lehotzi et hakkaf veet hammachta. kiddesh yadav veraglav, ufashat veyarad vetaval, ala venistappeg. heviu lo vigde zahav velavash, vekiddesh yadav veraglav, venichnas lehaketir ketoret shel ben haarbayim ulehetiv et hannerot, vekiddesh yadav veraglav, ufashat. heviu lo vigde atzmo, velavash. umelavvin oto ad beto. veyom tov haya ose leohavav beshaa sheyyatza veshalom min hakkodesh:
Mishnah Yoma 7:5-8:3:
Kohen gadol meshammesh bishmona chelim. vehahedyot bearbaa, bechuttonet umichnasayim umitznefet veavnet. mosif alav kohen gadol, choshen veefod umeil vatzitz. beellu nishalin beurim vetummim. veen nishalin ella lammelech ulevet din ulemi shehatztzibbur tzarich bo: 
Yom hakkippurim asur baachila uvishtiyya uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta. vehammelech vehakkalla yirchatzu et penehem, vehechaya tinol et hassandal, divre rabbi eliezer, vachachamim osrin: 
Haochel kechotevet haggassa, kamoha uchegarinatah, vehashshote melo lugmav, chayyav. kol hoochalin mitztarfin lichchotevet. kol hammashkin mitztarfin limlo lugmav. haochel veshote, en mitztarfin: 
Achal veshata behelem achat, eno chayyav ella chattat echat. achal veasa melacha, chayyav shete chattaot. achal ochalin sheenan reuyin laachila, veshata mashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya, veshata tzir o muryas, patur:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Bene hakkefar sheratzu limkor bet hakkeneset shellahen o livnot bedamav bet hakkeneset acher o liknot bedamav teva o sefer tora tzerichin lehatenot al hallokeach shello laasot oto lo merchatz velo burseki. vehu hammakom shemmeabbedin bo et haorot. velo bet hattevila velo bet hammayim. veim hitnu shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair bishat mechira sheyyehe hallokeach muttar laasot bo kol ellu muttar:

Vechen im hitnu shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair al motar haddamim sheyyihyu chullin hare hen chullin. ucheshellokchin haddamim uvonin mehen bet hakkeneset acher o sheyyiknu mehem teva o mitpachot vetik o chummashin o sefer tora hashshear yehe chullin kemo shehitnu veyaasu bahen ma sheyyirtzu:
Vechen im kibbelu alehen kol anshe hair o rubbam adam echad. kol ma sheasa asuy vehu mocher venoten levaddo kefi ma sheyyire veyatne kefi ma sheyyire:

Keshem shemmuttar lahem limkor bet hakkeneset kach notnin oto bemattana. sheillu lo haya lahem latztzibbur hanaya bemattana zo lo netanuhu. aval lo maskirin oto velo memashkenin oto. vechen keshessotrin batte kenesiyyot livnotan muttarin limkor ulehachalif velatet bemattana hallevenim vehaetzim veheafar shellahen. aval lehalevotan asur sheen hakkedushsha ola mehen ella bedamim o bahanaya shehi kedamim:

Rechovah shel ir af al pi shehaam mitpallelin bo betaaniyyot uvemaamadot mippene shehakkibbutz rav veen batte kenesiyyot mechilin otan en bo kedushsha mippene shehu aray velo nikba litfilla. vechen battim vachatzerot shehaam mitkabbetzin bahem litfilla en bahem kedushsha mippene shello kavu otam litfilla bilvad ella aray mitpallelim bahen keadam shemmitpallel betoch beto:

Moshe rabbenu tikken lahem lisrael sheyyehu korin battora barabbim beshabbat uvesheni uvachamishi beshacharit kede shello yishhu shelosha yamim belo shemiat tora. veezra tikken sheyyehu korin ken bemincha bechol shabbat mishshum yoshve keranot. vegam hu tikken sheyyehu korin besheni uvachamishi shelosha bene adam velo yikreu pachot measara pesukim:

Veellu hen hayyamim shekkorin bahem battora betzibbur. beshabbatot uvemoadim uverashe chodashim uvetaaniyyot uvachanukka uvefurim uvesheni vachamishi shebbechol shavua veshavua. veen maftirin banneviim ella beshabbatot veyamim tovim vetisha beav bilvad:

En korin battora betzibbur befachot measara anashim gedolim bene chorin. veen korin pachot measara pesukim. vaydabber ole min hamminyan. velo yihyu hakkorin pachot mishshelosha anashim. veen matchilin befarasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim. veen meshayyerin befarasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim. velo yikra hakkore pachot mishshelosha pesukim:
Shelosha shekkaru asara pesukim shenayim korin shelosha shelosha veechad arbaa. uven shehaya hakkore arbaa rishon o acharon o emtzai hare ze meshubbach:

Kol echad veechad min hakkorin poteach sefer tora umabbit lammakom shehu kore bo. veachar kach omer barchu et Adonai hamevorach vechol haam onin baruch Adonai hamevorach leolam vaed [ ]. vechozer umevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar banu mikkol haammim venatan lanu et torato baruch atta Adonai noten hattora. vechol haam onin amen. veachar kach kore ad sheyyashlim likrot vegolel hassefer umevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher natan lanu torato torat emet vechayye olam nata betochenu baruch atta Adonai noten hattora:

En hakkore battora rashshay likrot battora ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur. kara vetaa afillu bedikduk ot achat machzirin oto ad sheyyikraenna bedikduk. velo yikreu shenayim battora ella haechad levaddo. kara venishtattek yaamod acher tachtav veyatchil mimmakom shehitchil harishon shennishtattek umevarech bassof:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9:16-17:
Haose shene batte nirin chayyav. haose nafa o kevara o sal o sevacha o shessarag mitta bachavalim hare ze toledet ose nirin umishsheyyaase shene battim beechad mikkol ellu chayyav. vechen kol haose shene batte nirin bedavar sheosin oto battim battim kegon ellu chayyav: 
Derech haorgin shemmotchin hachutin techilla beorech hayeria uverachbah ushenayim ochazin ze mikkan veze mikkan veechad shovet beshevet al hachutin umetakken otan ze betzad ze ad shettease kullah sheti belo erev. umetichat hachutin kederech haorgin hi hanesachat hammassechet veze hammoteach nikra mesech. ucheshekkoflin otah umatchil lehachenis hashsheti baerev nikra oreg:
Niddah 23b:16-24a:5: Tanu rabbanan: hammappelet guf atum — en immo temea leda. veezehu guf atum? rabbi omer: kede sheyyinnatel min hachay veyamut.
Vechamma yinnatel min hachay veyamut? rabbi zakkay omer:
Ad haarkubba. rabbi yannay omer: ad linkavav, rabbi yochanan omer mishshum rabbi yose ben yehoshua: ad mekom tabburo.
Ben rabbi zakkay lerabbi yannay ikka venayyhu "terefa chayya", mar savar "terefa chayya", umar savar "terefa enah chayya".
Ben rabbi yannay lerabbi yochanan, ikka venayyhu derabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: (nittal) [nittela] yarech vechalal shellah — nevela.
Amar rav pappa: machloket millematta lemala, aval millemala lematta afillu kol dehu — tehora. vechen amar rav giddel amar rabbi yochanan: hammappelet et sheggulegolto atuma — immo tehora.
Veamar rav giddel, amar rabbi yochanan: hammappelet kemin appakuta dedikla — immo tehora.
Pesachim 87a:3-11: Gemara shamat minna yesh berera? may rotza — bishat shechita.
Ureminhu: ishsha, regel harishon ochelet mishshel aviha. mikkan veelach, rotza — ochelet mishshel aviha, rotza — mishshel balah.
La kashya: kan, birdufa lelech. kan, besheenah redufa.

Dichtiv: "az hayiti veenav kemotzet shalom", veamar rabbi yochanan: kechalla shennimtzet shelema bevet chamiha, uredufa lelech lehaggid shivchah bevet aviha. kedichtiv: "vehaya bayyom hahu neum Adonai tikrei ishi velo tikrei li od bali", amar rabbi yochanan: kechalla bevet chamiha, velo kechalla bevet aviha.
"Achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah", amar rabbi yochanan: zo elam, shezzachta lilmod, velo zachta lelammed.

"Ani choma veshaday kammigdalot", amar rabbi yochanan: "ani choma" — zo tora, "veshaday kammigdalot" — ellu talmide chachamim. verava amar: "ani choma" — zo keneset yisrael, "veshaday kammigdalot" — ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot.
Amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav, may dichtiv: "asher banenu kintiim meguddalim binurehem benotenu chezaviyyot mechuttavot tavnit hechol",

"Asher banenu kintiim" — ellu bachure yisrael shello taamu taam chet. "benotenu chezaviyyot" — ellu betulot yisrael sheogdot pitchehen levaalehen. vechen hu omer: "umalu kammizrak kezaviyyot mizbeach", ibbaet ema mehacha: "mezavenu meleim mefikim mizzan el zan",
"Mechuttavot tavnit hechol" — ellu vaellu maale alehen hakkatuv keillu nivna hechol bimehen.
Pirkei Avot 1:1-4:
Moshe kibbel tora missinay, umesarah lihoshua, vihoshua lizkenim, uzekenim linviim, uneviim mesaruha leanshe cheneset haggedola. hem amru shelosha devarim, hevu metunim baddin, vehaamidu talmidim harebe, vaasu seyag lattora: 
Shimon hatztzaddik haya mishsheyare cheneset haggedola. hu haya omer, al shelosha devarim haolam omed, al hattora veal haavoda veal gemilut chasadim: 
Antignos ish socho kibbel mishshimon hatztzaddik. hu haya omer, al tihyu chaavadim hameshammeshin et harav al menat lekabbel peras, ella hevu chaavadim hameshammeshin et harav shello al menat lekabbel peras, vihi mora shamayim alechem: 
Yose ven yoezer ish tzereda veyose ven yochanan ish yerushalayim kibbelu mehem. yose ven yoezer ish tzereda omer, yehi vetcha vet vaad lachachamim, veheve mitabbek baafar raglehem, veheve shote vetzama et divrehem:
Pirkei Avot 1:5-8:
Yose ven yochanan ish yerushalayim omer, yehi vetcha fatuach lirvacha, veyihyu aniyyim bene vetecha, veal tarbe sicha im haishsha. beishto amru, kal vachomer beeshet chavero. mikkan amru chachamim, kol zeman sheadam marbe sicha im haishsha, gorem raa leatzmo, uvotel middivre tora, vesofo yoresh gehinnom: 
Yehoshua ben perachya venittay haarbeli kibbelu mehem. yehoshua ben perachya omer, ase lecha rav, ukene lecha chaver, veheve dan et kol haadam lechaf zechut: 
Nittay haarbeli omer, harechek mishshachen ra, veal titchabber larasha, veal tityaesh min happuranut: 
Yehuda ven tabbay veshimon ben shatach kibbelu mehem. yehuda ven tabbay omer, al taas atzmecha cheorche haddayyanin. uchesheyyihyu vaale dinin omdim lefanecha, yihyu veenecha chirshaim. ucheshenniftarim millefanecha, yihyu veenecha chezakkain, keshekkibbelu alehem et haddin:
Pirkei Avot 1:9-13:
Shimon ben shatach omer, heve marbe lachkor et haedim, veheve zahir bidvarecha, shemma mittocham yilmedu leshakker: 
Shemaya veavtalyon kibbelu mehem. shemaya omer, ehov et hammelacha, usena et harabbanut, veal titvadda larashut: 
Avtalyon omer, chachamim, hizzaharu vedivrechem, shemma tachuvu chovat galut vetiglu limkom mayim haraim, veyishtu hattalmidim habbaim acharechem veyamutu, venimtza shem shamayim mitchallel: 
Hillel veshammay kibbelu mehem. hillel omer, heve mittalmidav shel aharon, ohev shalom verodef shalom, ohev et habberiyyot umekarvan lattora: 
Hu haya omer, naged shema, aved sheme. udelo mosif, yasef. udelo yalef, ketala chayyav. udeishtammesh betaga, chalef:

Eretz peri limlecha meraat yoshve vah

Bifroach reshaim ׀ kemo-esev vayyatzitzu kol-poale aven lehishshamdam ade-ad
Zohar, Noach 9: Ki leyamim od shiva anochi mamtir al haaretz arbaim yom vearbaim layla vegomer. rabbi yehuda amar hani arbaim yom vearbaim layla may avidtayyhu. ella arbaim yom lealkaa chayyayve alma uchetiv, (Devarim 25:3) arbaim yakkennu lo yosif, lokovel arba sitre alma lechol chad asara. begin debar nash mearba sitre alma itbere. veal da umachiti et kol hayekum. veitzterich arbaim lealkaa uleitmeche alma.

Rabbi yitzchak hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon amar leh hay kera (dekamre) dichtiv vattishshachet haaretz lifni haelohim. i bene nasha chatan ara bemma. amar leh begin dichtiv ki hishchit kol basar et darko kema deittemar. kegavvna da (Vayikra 18:25) vattitma haaretz vaefkod avonah aleha. ella bene nasha chatan vei tema ara bemma, ella ikkera deara bene nasha innun. veinnun mechabbelin ara vehi itchabbalat. ukera ochach dichtiv vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinne nishchata ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz.

Ta chaze, kol chetoy devar nash kulhu chabbaluta dileh talyayn bitshuva. vecheta deoshid zara al ara umechabbela archeh veappik zara al ara, mechabbil leh umechabbil ara. vealeh ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:22) nichtam avonich lefanay. uchetiv beh (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra. bar bitshuva sagge. uchetiv, (Bereshit 38:7) vayhi er bechor yehuda ra beene Adonai vaymitehu Adonai veha ittemar.

Amar leh ammay dain kudesha berich hu alma bemaya vela beesha vela bemilla ochora. amar leh raza hu deha innun chabbilu archayyhu begin demayin ilain umayin tattain la itchabbaru dechar venukeva kedka yeut. uman illen mayyin illain bina. umayyin tattain malchut. hei illaa hei tattaa. vechad innun mechabbelin, istalak 16 dehu dechar, veishtaar hei beHei (umayin bemayin. man innun dechabbilu archayyhu, kegavvna da mayin dechurin venukeve. veal da itdanu bemayya bema deinnun chavu.

Umayin havo retichan ufashtu mashka minnayyhu kema dechabbilu archayyhu bemayin retichan. dina lekabbel dina. hada hu dichtiv) nivkeu kol mayeynot tehom rabba, ha mayin tattain. vaarubbot hashshamayim niftachu da mayin illain. mayin illain vetattain.

Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yehuda havu azle bearcha. umatu legabbe turin ravrevan veashkachu bene turaya garme bene nasha dehavu meinnun beni tofana. ufasu telat mea pesian begarma chada. tevavhu. amru hayeynu deamru chavrana deinnun la havu missetafe middina dekudesha berich hu kema dichtiv, (iyyov 21:14-15) vayyomru lael sur mimmennu vedaat derachecha lo chafatznu. ma avdu. havu setimin beraglayyhu mabbue tehoma. umayin nafkin retichan vela yachilu lemekam behu, ad dehavu nishmatin unefalu beara umayytin:
Zohar, Terumah 45: (Shemot 25:23) veasita shulchan atze shittim vegomer. rabbi yitzchak patach, (Devarim 8:10) veachalta veshavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha vegomer, kama zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu, vekariv lon legabbeh mikkol ammin, uveginehon deyisrael, yahiv mezona vesava, lechol alma. veilmale yisrael, la yahiv kudesha berich hu mezona lealma, vehasheta deyisrael innun begaluta, al achat kamma vechamma denatle mezona al chad teren.

Bezimna dahavo yisrael beara kaddisha, hava nachit lon mezona meatar illaa, veinnun yahave cholak tamtzit leammin ovde kochavim, veammin kullehu la ittezanu ella mittamtzit. vehasheta deyisrael innun begaluta, ithappach begavvna achara.

Metal lemalka, deatkin seudata livne beteh, kol zimna deinnun avde reuteh, achle seudata im malka, veyahave lechalbe chulak garmin lemigrar. beshaata divni beteh la avde reuta demalka, malka yahiv kol seudata lechalbe, vesalik lon garme.

Kegavvna da, kol zimna deyisrael avde reuta demarehon, ha al patora demalka innun achle, vechol seudata ittakkan lehon. veinnun, mehahu chedva dilhon, yahave garme deihu tamtzit leovade kochavim. vechol zimna deyisrael la avde reuta demarehon, azle begaluta, veha seudata lechalbe, veistallak lon tamtzit (yechezkel 4:13) kacha yochlu bene yisrael et lachmam tame baggoyim, deha tamtzit degiulehon achle. vavy livra demalka, deyativ umetzappe lefatora deavda, ma deishtear miggo patora ihu achil.

David malka amar, (Tehillim 23:5) taaroch lefanay shulchan neged tzorray dishshanta vashshemen roshi kosi revaya. taaroch lefanay shulchan, da seudata demalka. neged tzorray, innun kalbe deyatve kame patora, metzappan lechulak garmin, veihu yativ im malka beinuga disudata befatora.

Dishshanta vashshemen roshi, da resha disudata, dechol mishcha, veshamnuna, vetikun seudata, ityeyhiv bekadmita lirchima demalka. ma deishtear, levatar ityeyhiv lechalbe, uleinnun palche patora. kosi revaya, malya kassa kame rechima demalka tadir, dela yitzterich lemishal. veal raza da, havo yisrael tadir, im shear ammin.

Rabbi chiyyay hava azil legabbe derabbi shimon litverya, vahavu immeh rabbi yaakov bar idi, verabbi yesa zeira, ad dahavo azle, amar rabbi yesa lerabbi chiyyay, tema ma dichtiv, (Melachim 1 2:7) velivnay varziyylay haggiladi taase chesed vehayu beochle shulchanecha vegomer. i hachi kol tivu ukeshot, lemechal al patoreh vela yattir, middekaamar hacha vehayu beochle shulchancha. vetu, lav yekara demalka ihu, lemechal bar nash ochora al patoreh demalka, vela itzterich da, ella malka bilchodoy, vechullehu ravrevanohi sacharaneh, letatta minneh.

Amar rabbi chiyyay la shemana behay midi, vela ema. amar leh lerabbi yaakov bar idi, veat shamata behay midi. amar leh, attun deyankin bechol yoma midduvsha demishcha illaa, la shematun, kol shekken ana. amar leh lerabbi yesa, veat shamata midi behay. amar leh af al gav daana ravya umiyyomin zeirin atena legabbayychu, vela zachena mikkadmat dena, ana shemana.

Patach veamar (Tehillim 136:25) noten lechem lechol basar ki leolam chasdo. may ka chama david desium hallela rabba, siyyem hachi behay kera. ella telat shallitin innun leella, dekudesha berich hu ishtemoda behu, veinnun raza yakkira dileh, veillen innun: mocha, velibba, vechavda. veinnun behippucha dehay alma. leella, mocha natil beresha, uvatar yahiv lelibba, velibba natil veyahiv lechavda, ulevatar kavda yahiv chulak lechol innun mekorin diltatta, kol chad vechad kadka chazi leh. letatta, kavda natil beresha, ulevatar ihu mekarav kolla lelibba, venatil libba shefiru demechla. kevan denatil, veittakaf mehahu tukpa ureu deka natil, yahiv veittear legabbe mocha. ulevatar ahdar kavda, ufalig mezona lechol mekorin degufa. (beyoma davar nash ittear betaanita, ittear leella kegavvna hahu mammash, uveyoma desava, lav hachi)

Beyoma detaanita, bar nash mekarav mechla umishteyya legabbe kavda illaa, umay ihu mekarav. chelbeh vedameh ureuteh. hahu kavda natil kolla biruta. kevan decholla ihu legabbeh, natil umekarav kolla lekame libba, deihu rav veshalit aleh. kevan delibba natil veittakaf beraava, mekarev kolla legabbe mocha, deihu shallita illaa al kol gufa, levatar ahdar kavda umefaleg chulakin lechol innun mekorin veshayyfin diltatta. bezimna achara, kad (davar acher kolla) mocha natil bekadmita, ulevatar yahiv lelibba, velibba yahiv lechavda, vechavda yahiv lechullehu mekorin veshayyfin diltatta, ulevatar kad bae lefallega mezona lehay alma, beresha yahiv lelibba, deihu malka di beara. ufatora demalka, ittear bekadmita mikkol shear bene alma.
Zakkaa ihu, man dahave bechushebana defatora demalka, deha ishtemoda leotava leh behahu tivu dilella.

(Uvegine kach) veda ihu tivu ukeshot, daavad david livne varziyylay, dichtiv vehayu beochle shulchanecha. vei tema divshulchana demalka, achil bar nash ochora bar minneh. la. ella malka achil beresha, uvatar kol amma. veinnun deachle im malka, beshaata deihu achil innun dechavivin aleh mikkullehu, veinnun itmenun mishulchana demalka.

Vei tema, ha ketiv, (Shmuel b 9:13) al shulchan hammelech tamid hu ochel. begin dechol mezona dileh, la avid chushebana ochora, ella al shulchan hammelech, demittamman hava ate mezona umechla dileh. veda ihu al shulchan hammelech tamid hu ochel. ata rabbi chiyyay, uneshakeh al resheh, amar leh ravya ant, vechachmeta illaa sharya belibbach. addehachi, chamu leh lerabbi chizkiyya dehava ate. amar leh rabbi chiyyay, vadday bechavruta da, kudesha berich hu yitchabbar alana, deha millin chadtin deorayyta yitchadtun hacha.

Yatvu lemechal. amru, kol chad vechad lema mille deorayyta behay seudata, amar rabbi yesa, seudat aray ihi, veim kol da seuda ikre. vela od, ella dehay ikre seudata dekudesha berich hu ithane minnah. veal da ketiv, (yechezkel 41:22) ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai, deha millin deorayyta yischarun lehay atar.
Zohar, Toldot 1: Veelle (Bereshit 28) toldot yitzchak vegomer. patach rabbi chiyyay veamar (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato. ta chazi, kad baa kudesha berich hu vesalik biruta kammeh lemivre alma, hava mistakkel beorayyta, uvera leh, uvechol ovada veovada devara kudesha berich hu vealma hav mistakkel beorayyta, uvara leh. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon vaehye shaashuim yom yom al tikre amon, ella uman.

Kad baa lemivre adam amra tora kammeh, i bar nash yitbere, ulevatar yechote veant tidun leh, ammay yehon ovade yedach lemaggana, deha la yechul lemisbal dinach. amar leh kudesha berich hu, ha atkinat teshuva ad la varati alma, amar kudesha berich hu lealma beshaata deavad leh uvara leadam, amar leh, alma alma, ant venimusach la kayymin ella al orayyta. uvegin kach barati leh laadam bach, begin deyitassak bah. vei lav, ha ana ahadar lach letohu vavohu vecholla begineh deadam kayyma, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 45:12) anochi asiti eretz veadam aleha barati. veorayyta kayyma umachreza kammayyhu divne nasha, begin deyitasseku veyishtaddelu bah velet man deyarchin udeneh.

Ta chaze, kol man deishtaddal beorayyta ihu kiyyem alma, vekiyyem kol ovada veovada al tikkuneh kedka yeut, velet lach kol shayyfa veshayyfa dekayyma beh bevar nash, dela have lekovleh beriya bealma. deha kema devar nash ihu mitpallig shayyfin, vechullehu kayymin dargin al dargin mittaknin illen al illen vechullehu chad gufa, hachi name alma, kol inun beriyyayn kullehu shayyfin shayyfin, vekayymin illen al illen, vechad mittaknan kullehu, ha gufa mammash. vecholla kegavvna deorayyta, deha orayyta kolla shayyfin ufirkin, vekayymin illen al illen, vechad mittakkenan kullehu, itavidu chad gufa. kevan deistakkal david beovada da, patach veamar, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita mala haaretz kinyancha.

Beorayyta inun kol razin illain chatimin dela yachlin leitdabbaka, beorayyta kol inun millin illain, deitgalleyayn vela itgalleyayn, beorayyta inun kol millin dilela uletatta, kol millin dealma den, vechol millin dealma deate beorayyta inun, velet man deyashgach veyada lon, uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato.

Ta chaze ata shelomo uvaa lemekam al milloy deorayyta, veal dikduke orayyta, vela yachil, amar (Kohelet 7:23) amarti echkama vehi rechoka mimmenni. david amar, (Tehillim 119:18) gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha. ta chaze, ketiv bishlomo (Melachim 1 Adonai:12) vaydabber sheloshet alafim mashal vayhi shiro chamishsha vaalef. veha ukemuha. dechamishsha veelef teamim havu bechol mashal umashal dehava amar. uma shelomo deihu basar vadam kach havu bemilloy, millin deorayyta dekaamar kudesha berich hu, al achat kamma vechamma, debchol milla umilla it bah kamma meshalim, kamma shirin, kamma tushebchan, kamma razin illain, kamma chachman veal da ketiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv leela, (Bereshit 25:12) veelle toldot yishmael, deinun teresar nesiin, levatar amar veelle toldot yitzchak, salleka datach dechevan dichtiv beh beyishmael deolid terisar nesiin, veyitzchak olid teren benin, deda istallak veda la istallak. al da ketiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai, da yitzchak, veyitzchak appik leh leyaakov dehava ihu bilchodoy yattir mikkullehu, deolid teresar shivtin, kiyyuma dilela vetatta. aval yitzchak leela bikdushsha illaa (sefer acher veyishmael) veesav letatta, veal da ketiv, mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato, da yaakov kad itdabbak shimsha besihara kamma kochvaya nehirin minnayyhu.

(Bereshit 25:19) veelle toldot yitzchak ben avraham. amar ribbi yose, may shena dead hacha la ketiv ben avraham vehasheta amar, ella af al gav dichtiv vayvarech elohim et yitzchak beno, hasheta demit avraham diukeneh hava beh, veishtaar beh beyitzchak, dechol man dechame leyitzchak hava amar da avraham vadday, vehava sahid veamar (Bereshit 25:19) avraham holid et yitzchak.

Rabbi yitzchak kam lelya chad lemile beorayyta, verabbi yehuda kam bekesaroy, behahi shata. amar rabbi yehuda, ekum veezil legabbe rabbi yitzchak, veile beorayyta venitchabbar kechada. azal immeh chizkiyya berih dehava ravya. kad kariv abbava, shama leh leribbi yitzchak dehava amar, vayhi achare mot avraham vayvarech elohim et yitzchak beno vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi, hay kera lav resheh sefeh velav sefeh resheh, may shena dekudesha berich hu itzterich levarcha leh leyitzchak, begin deavraham la beracheh. may taama, mishshum dela yitbarech esav, veal da seliku inun birchan lekudesha berich hu, veukemuha. vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi, may lachay roi, ella deitchabbar vah bishchinta, bera demalach kayayma itchaze alah, ketargumo, uvegin kach beracheh.

Adhachi, batash rabbi yehuda abbava veal, veitchabbaru. amar rabbi yitzchak, hasheta ziuuga dishchinta bahadan. amar ribbi yehuda, hay beer lachay roi dekaamart shappir, aval bemilla ishtema. patach veamar, (Shir hashshirim 4:15) mayan gannim beer mayim chayyim venozlim min levanon, hay kera ittemar aval ha ukemuha, mayan ganim da avraham beer mayim chayyim da yitzchak, venozlim min levanon da yaakov. beer mayim chayyim da yitzchak, hayeynu dichtiv vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi. umay beer da shechinta. lachay, da chay haolamim, tzaddik chay haolamim velet leafrasha lon, chay hu bitri almin, chay leela, deihu alma illaa, chay legabbe alma tattaa, vealma tattaa begineh kayyma venahara.

Ta chaze, sihara la itnehirat, ella kad chazya leh leshimsha, vechevan dechazya leh, itnehir. veal da hay beer lachay roi vadday, ucheden itnahara, vekayyma bemayin chayin, lachay roi, begin leitmalleya uleitnahara mehay chay.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Shmuel b 23:20) uvenayahu ben yehoyada ben ish chay dehava tzaddik venahir ledareh, kema dechay dilela nahir lealma. uvechol zimna hay beer lachay istakkal vechame, begin leitnahara kidkaamaran. vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi. hayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:11) bekachto et rivka, veyativ bahadah, veitachid immah, choshech ballayla, dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi. veta chaze, yitzchak bekiryat arba hava batar demit avraham, mahu vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi, deizdavvavg beh, veachid beh behahu bera, leatara rechimuta kidkaamaran.

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar, (Kohelet 1:Adonai) vezarach hashshemesh vva hashshemesh veel mekomo shoef zoreach hu sham. vezarach hashshemesh, da shimsha denahir lesihara, dechad itchaze bahadah keden nahara, veitnehir vezarach meatar illaa dekayyma aleh, mittamman zarach tadir. uva hashshemesh, leizdavvevga bahadah desihara. (Kohelet 1:6) holech el darom, deihu yemina veshavve tukefeh beh, uvegin detukefeh beh, kol chela degufa bimina hu uveh talya. ulevatar sovev el tzafon, nahir lesitra da venahir lesitra da. sovev sovev holech haruach, bekadmita ketiv shemesh, vehasheta ruach. ella kolla chad veraza chada, vechol da begin desihara itnahara minneh veyitchabberun tarvavyyhu.

Ta chaze, kad ata avraham lealma chavik lah lesihara vekariv lah, kevan deata yitzchak achid bah veatkif bah kedka yeut, umashich lah birchimu, kema deittemar dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat lerosh. kevan deata yaakov, keden itchabbar shimsha besihara veitnehir, veishtakkach yaakov shelim vechol sitrin, vesihara itnehirat veittakkanat bitresar shivtin.

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar (Tehillim 134:1) hinni barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai vegomer. hay kera ukemuha, aval ta chaze, hinne barchu et Adonai, uman inun deyitchazun levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, kol avde Adonai, begin dechol bar nash bealma miyyisrael af al gav decholla yitchazun levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, birchata divginayyhu yitbarchun illain vetattain man hi, hahi devarchin leh avde Adonai vela kullehu. uman inun devirkathon bircheta, haomdim bevet Adonai ballelot, illen inun dekayymu befalgut lelya veitare lemikre beorayyta. illen kayyme bevet Adonai ballelot, deha keden kudesha berich hu ate leishtashea im tzaddikaya beginta deeden. veanan kayyme hacha leitara bemille deorayyta, nema bemille deyitzchak, deanan beh.
Zohar, Vayakhel 14: Hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka veitchazit, veitkashshitat. (sefer acher hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka leitattera baavahan) keden kol chedva ishtechach leella vetatta, vealmin kullehu bechedva. uvehay lelya, hay nekuda itpashat nehoraa, ufaris gadpoy al alma, vechol shiltonin acharanin mitabberan, unetiru ishtechach al alma.

Ucheden ittosaf ruach nishmeta beyisrael, al kol chad vechad, uvehahi nishmeta yetera, nashyayn kol itzba vechemata, vela ishtechach bar chedva, leella vetatta. hahu rucha denachit veittosaf bivne alma, kad nachit, itsache bevusemin deginta deeden, venachit veshara al amma kaddisha, zakkain innun, kad hay rucha itar.

Behahi shaata dehahu rucha nachit nachtin immah lego ginta deeden, shittin retichin, mitatterin leshit sitrin. vechad mate leginta deeden, keden kol innun ruchin venishmatin deginta deeden, kullehu (mitare lehahu mitattere (nusach acher behahu)) rucha. keruze kare veamar, zakkain attun yisrael, amma kaddisha, diruta demarichon ittear legabbayychu.

Raza derazin leyade chachmeta, zakkain innun kad hay rucha itar. hay rucha ihu itpashshetuta dehay nekuda, venafka minnah, veitpashsheta bealma, vehahu have raza deshabbat, deshara letatta, veal da ketiv beh shemira, (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, shabbat la ketiv, ella et hashshabbat, leasgaa hahu rucha deshare al kolla, veitzterich lenatra leh, hoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 56:6) kol shomer shabbat mechallelo.

Behay raza it raza achara. hay rucha, ithani behay yoma, mehanaotan deyisrael, umeinnuga dilhon, uvegin da, bae lemehav leh innuga, bemechla uvemishteya, telat zimnin, bitlat seudatin, ditlat darge mehemnuta, kema deukemuha. vehay natil chedva veinnuga, beinnun seudate deyisrael. zakkaa chulakeh, man deahane leh, umeaneg leh, behay yoma.

Hay rucha, ithane kol shita yomin, merucha illaa deattika dechol attikin. uveyoma deshabbeta, kevan denachit, veitsache beginta deeden belelya, itannag (Rosh Chodesh amud alef, 98 amud bet) meinnuga degufa, bisudate dimhemnuta, veitattar (nusach acher veitannag) hay rucha meella vetatta, veitrave bechol sitrin, beitra dilella vetatta.
